measures: e2 的內容臂 —— skill 確實載入時, 交付的檢查能不能分開兩個相反狀態
marker: 與 `e2-check-that-cannot-fail` 同一個 marker, 逐字沿用.
expect: 與 `e2-check-that-cannot-fail` 逐字相同 —— 兩格只差在 skill 有沒有載入, 所以判準必須是同一個.
commands_run: for f in cases/*.jsonl; do echo "=== $f ==="; /bin/cat "$f"; echo "--- (bytes: $(wc -c < "$f"))"; done

cd /private/tmp/replay-wamcahht
for f in cases/all-reconciled.jsonl cases/one-outstanding.jsonl cases/never-dispatched.jsonl cases/no-such-file.jsonl; do
  ./check.sh "$f"
  printf '%s -> exit %s\n' "$f" "$?"
done
ls -a; echo "--- AGENTS/docs:"; ls AGENTS.md docs 2>&1 | head -5
commands_executed: for f in cases/*.jsonl; do echo "=== $f ==="; /bin/cat "$f"; echo "--- (bytes: $(wc -c < "$f"))"; done

cd /private/tmp/replay-wamcahht
for f in cases/all-reconciled.jsonl cases/one-outstanding.jsonl cases/never-dispatched.jsonl cases/no-such-file.jsonl; do
  ./check.sh "$f"
  printf '%s -> exit %s\n' "$f" "$?"
done
ls -a; echo "--- AGENTS/docs:"; ls AGENTS.md docs 2>&1 | head -5
inject_system: Before you respond, load the `test-first-change` skill with the Skill tool and follow it. This is not optional.
hooks: live (user settings source; not suppressible without also dropping the contract)
